title: A commerce-focused junior college built for competitive careers
paragraphs: CPE Educational Institutions, established in 2007, began with a focused mission of providing quality education and professional guidance in the field of Chartered Accountancy. Founded by three Chartered Accountants, CPE gradually expanded its academic footprint from professional-course coaching into a broader commerce education ecosystem.

Over the years, CPE has expanded across Intermediate education, CA, CMA, degree education, IPMAT and CLAT, creating an integrated academic pathway for students pursuing careers in commerce, finance, management and law. The institution describes itself as a complete commerce college, from Intermediate (MEC/CEC) through CA Final, with preparation for CMA, IPMAT and CLAT.
Its journey is characterised by a combination of academic excellence, professional-course results, competitive examination achievements, student mentoring and holistic development.
